jobs.description:
We are looking for a finance-minded Program Manager to support capital planning operations, co-own the annual operating plan (OP1/OP2) process, and contribute to broader strategic programs across the Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC). This role sits at the intersection of finance, process automation, and program execution — you will support the capital appropriation request (CAR) process, help pull together business cases and OP entitlements, and provide the financial rigor that shapes how Tech-SC plans and allocates investment.

You do not need to be a career finance professional — but you should be comfortable with financial concepts, able to build a business case, and eager to grow into a role where financial analysis drives program decisions. This is not a passive reporting role: you will co-own the OP1/OP2 planning cycle alongside the Rhythm of the Business PM, help drive automation of capital planning processes, and execute on the cross-functional Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement (SCOPE) portfolio alongside the broader team. The specific balance of capital planning versus broader program work will be shaped with your manager based on team needs.

Key job responsibilities
Capital Planning Support

- Support the capital appropriation request (CAR) process across Tech-SC's portfolio, partnering with existing capital planning owners

- Contribute to capital planning cycles, BOM-level coordination, and program-level financial deliverables

- Build depth in capital planning governance and financial compliance over time

OP1/OP2 Co-Ownership & Financial Analysis

- Co-own the annual operating plan (OP1/OP2) process alongside the Rhythm of the Business PM

- Pull together business cases, OP entitlements, and investment justifications for Tech-SC initiatives

- Provide financial analysis and direction across SCOPE's strategic initiative portfolio

- Partner with program owners to assess investment trade-offs, entitlement sizing, and cost-benefit framing

- Serve as a financial lens on new business intake decisions and planning-cycle prioritization

Process Automation & Innovation

- Define the vision and roadmap for automating capital planning appropriation requests

- Leverage AI tools to build agents, workflows, and mechanisms that reduce manual effort and accelerate cycle times

- Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive financial processes through intelligent automation

General Program Management

- Contribute to cross-functional programs spanning all pillars of Tech-SC

- Support intake management, delivery assurance, and stakeholder coordination as capacity allows

- Drive operational cadences (MBR/QBR inputs, goal tracking, dependency management) within assigned programs

A day in the life
Your day blends financial analysis, program execution, and automation. You'll partner with SCOPE program owners to build business cases and size OP entitlements, support the CAR process alongside capital planning owners, and co-drive OP1/OP2 inputs with the Rhythm of the Business PM. You'll work across partner teams — helping them navigate intake and planning decisions. A recurring theme: finding where manual financial and planning work can be automated with AI, then building the agents and mechanisms to eliminate it. You'll operate with high visibility to senior Tech-SC leadership.

About the team
The Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement (SCOPE) team is the central program management and business operations function for Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC). We coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage new business intake, and drive delivery assurance across our partner organizations supporting a $1B asset portfolio spanning Amazon Worldwide Stores and AWS infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Amazon is building the next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many millions of units of inventory, and ensure that customers get what they want when we promised. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well. We are constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating the delivery of products and packages which includes building custom hardware and applying robotics, autonomy, supply chain optimization, machine learning, manipulation, image processing, and real-time data processing using distributed systems.

WW Technology Deployment- Systems Integration is seeking a talented and solutions-oriented Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own the development and optimization of commissioning processes and integration for new automation systems. Your work will focus on defining the goals of all key stakeholder functions responsible for delivering, driving prioritization and maintaining commitments on program delivery while managing oversight of internal team deliverables.



Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrate ownership by acting as the Single Point of Contact for program needs.
- Advance the maturity of programs through simplification, automation, and integration.
- Deep understanding the technology and systems at a technical level; provide guidance, recommendation, and reporting on program direction and progress.
- Lead the development of org-level metrics to ensure the most impactful delivery goals are formulated to meet program goals.
- Coordinate working with each stakeholder team to ensure there is commitment to SMART goals that ladders into the org-level committed goal.
- Organize internal team’s technical development roadmap and drive execution, testing and release.
- Establish a cadence and mechanism to review goal statuses and progress towards committed SMART goals.
- Manage escalations or misalignment when there are risks to delivering committed services with high quality; manages tradeoff decisions with key stakeholders.
- Work with stakeholder teams to determine the appropriate escalation, review process, and resolution for delivery blockers.
- Establish a cadence to review the overall performance of the stakeholder teams, the timeline, and progress to overall deliverables.
- Manage any associated Correction of Error (COE) and Lessons Learned documentation and drive. follow-up actions that to solve for root cause with responsible owners.


A day in the life

jobs.description:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and partnership you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

Amazon Robotics is seeking a talented and motivated Technical Program Manager (TPM) who will be part of the Sortation Vertical focused on next generation sortation products, as well as supporting the existing solutions in the field. The TPM will manage the full project lifecycle of innovative programs aimed at improving the efficiency and lowering the cost of Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers and Sortation Centers. This position is responsible for the planning and execution of NPI & Sustaining programs while serving as liaison between Systems Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Solutions, Manufacturing & Supply Chain, Product, & Customer Support.

If you are a Technical Project Manager, Technical Program Manager, or Engineer looking to grow your skills in project/program management, with strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, an ability to influence business and technical leaders in a dynamic environment and the desire to be a contributor to Amazon's next generation fulfillment & logistics technology, we want to talk with you. Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to build systems that benefit millions of customers and support sellers spanning the globe.

The ideal candidate will draw upon exemplary program / project management, critical thinking, and problem solving skills, and a passion for creating reliable and maintainable systems. The candidate should be open to new challenges, strong at multi-tasking, innovative, creative, self-directed and a great team player. Candidate should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and development teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead the effective and efficient delivery of complex sortation solutions, working across all engineering disciplines.
* Interact with key stakeholders to define and deliver against project goals, including both technical and operational deliverables
* Collaborate cross functionally for extensible solution development and integration. An ideal candidate has experience with complex system design, including experience integrating hardware and software deliverables
* Drive consensus on technical decisions and ensure the appropriate resources are employed to deliver high quality results
* Lead the development and decomposition of comprehensive functional requirements & specifications, partnering with Product Management and Systems Engineering.
* Identify, assess, track and mitigate issues and risks at the program level
* Create, maintain and disseminate project information to stakeholders
* Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
* Develop and drive engineering project schedules
* Deliver programs across all engineering disciplines including Hardware, Software, Solutions, Regulatory Compliance, System QA, and Deployment.
* Partner with groups external to the Sortation Team to successfully deliver on project goals
* Triage, prioritize, and execute against incoming requests from the field or partner teams
